prompt: Build for this brief: A cultural venue; visitors browse works, plan visits and find events. Use Spectrum 1-2: page #F9FBFA, text #1F292D, accent #1D2286, secondary surface #EFE7EB, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in League Gothic and reading text in Inter; narrow display hierarchy with neutral body text. Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Use body 18px, heading 48px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
